RELATED SERVICES
AGREEMENT DATE
August 13th 2026
PARTIES
COMPANY: Nexora Intelligence Private Limited, a company incorporated in India, having its corporate

CONSULTANT: Rhea Anaya, Resident of Banjara Hills, Hyderabad, Telangana 500034.
BACKGROUND
The Company is engaged in artificial intelligence, software development, data analytics, machine learning,
and related consulting services.
The Consultant has technical knowledge, skill, and experience relevant to artificial intelligence, data
analytics, and related technology services.
The Company has requested the Consultant to provide consultancy services, and the Consultant has
agreed to provide those services.

APPOINTMENT AND ROLE
The Company appoints the Consultant to provide consultancy services in artificial intelligence, data
analytics, and related technology services.
CONSULTANT ROLE: AI Solutions Consultant
SCOPE OF SERVICES
1. Design, develop, test, and support artificial intelligence and machine learning solutions.
2. Prepare, transform, validate, and analyze data required for AI and analytics initiatives.
3. Assist with retrieval-augmented generation systems, including document processing, retrieval,
evaluation, and related AI workflows.
4. Assist with intelligent automation and other generative AI applications.

evaluation, and related AI workflows.
4. Assist with intelligent automation and other generative AI applications.
5. Conduct experimentation, benchmarking, model evaluation, and trend analysis.
6. Interpret analytical and model outputs and communicate findings through reports, dashboards, and
presentations.
7. Participate in AI and data projects with the Company and its clients.
8. Provide other related consultancy services reasonably requested by the Company.
FEES AND COMPENSATION
FIXED FEE: Rs. 1,85,000 per Month. The Consultant will invoice the Company on the first day of each
month for services provided and performed.
VARIABLE FEE: None. The Consultant is entitled only to the fixed monthly fee described above, unless the
parties later agree otherwise in writing.

VARIABLE FEE: None. The Consultant is entitled only to the fixed monthly fee described above, unless the
parties later agree otherwise in writing.
ADDITIONAL COMPENSATION: None.
INVOICE PAYMENT: The Company will pay valid invoices within 5 working days after receipt.

TAXES: TDS and other applicable deductions will be handled according to applicable law.
PAYMENT METHOD: Payments will be made by bank transfer to the bank account designated by the
Consultant.
EXPENSES
The Consultant may claim reimbursement for reasonable and necessary expenses incurred while providing
services. All such expenses must be approved by the Company in writing before they are incurred, and the
Consultant must provide receipts or other proof of payment.
TERM
EFFECTIVE DATE: September 1st 2026
EXPIRY DATE: August 31st 2027
The Agreement automatically renews for one-year periods unless either party terminates it in writing with
one month's notice.
The Company may terminate the Agreement immediately in the event of a material breach by the
Consultant.

During the term of this Agreement, the Consultant will not enter into a competing engagement that

written consent.

All work product created by the Consultant specifically for the Company or its clients while performing the

The Consultant must keep confidential all non-public information, materials, data, documentation, business

The Consultant may not disclose or use confidential information outside the scope of this Agreement
without prior written consent, except when disclosure is required by law.

Upon termination of this Agreement, the Consultant must return Company property, equipment, documents,
